Question 2
?

The graph shows a portion of the curve y=cos⁡x and y=32. Which of the following generates the x-values of all of their points of intersection? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=60∘+n⋅360∘,x=300∘+n⋅360∘
b
x=30∘+n⋅180∘
c
x=30∘+n⋅360∘,x=330∘+n⋅360∘
d
x=30∘+n⋅360∘,x=150∘+n⋅360∘
e
x=60∘+n⋅180∘
